**Unofficial** companion app for the AULA S98 Pro. Needs an Apple silicon Mac on macOS 13 or newer, and the keyboard connected by USB cable.

1. Unzip, and drag **Aula S98 Pro Companion** to Applications.
2. Open it. macOS will refuse the first time, because this free project isn't notarized by Apple.
3. Go to **System Settings › Privacy & Security**, scroll down, and choose **Open Anyway**.

The zip also holds `aula-s98`, the command-line tool. Copy it somewhere on your `PATH`.
